# column

Arrange text into columns or a table through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/column -t input.txt

moonx cli/column -t -s : records.txt
```

Read files or stdin. Table mode splits fields; grid mode arranges entries using the selected output width.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-t`, `--table` | create a table |
| `-s VALUE`, `--separator VALUE` | table delimiters (default: space and TAB) |
| `-o VALUE`, `--output-separator VALUE` | Set the table column separator. Default: `"  "`. |
| `-c VALUE`, `--output-width VALUE` | output width (default: COLUMNS or 80) |
| `-x`, `--fillrows` | fill rows before columns |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

- Automatic terminal-width detection and the complete util-linux table grammar are unavailable. Large input may use temporary spool files.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
